title: X-LAB AD8 season complete-bike specification
notes: Official mainland specification for the R7170 Di2 / Branta C50 TEAM complete bike. It states 7.6 kg without pedals in size M, Toray T800 x M40X carbon, T47, Shimano 105 Di2 2x12, 11-34T, 50/34T, Michelin Pro 5 700x28C tires, five-size geometry and a 100 kg maximum load.
